title: A resumed or restarted standing session has a merge role, so it can merge its own PR
why: Measured 15:00 CST Nov 17 in triage 11's container: no merge role record exists (~/.claude/state/merge-role.json absent), so merge --confirm refuses 'this session may not merge'. Recording it by hand was denied by the auto-mode classifier.
note: Merged: pull request 3639 by REST (merged 21:49:30 CST Nov 17, state closed and merged true, head 16a8d0355c). Merged by triage 11 under the standing role and the owner's 19:05 CST grant, after round 1 (sonnet, head 6c48fd4994) and two fix checks (sonnet, heads 32f4a31d37 and 16a8d0355c), lane lint PASS on the live head (438.5 s) and a green run on main before it (a9b6f78f3a). The afterMerge step `bash merge/install_from_main.sh` failed with exit 127 because it ran from the roadmap-branch checkout, which has no merge/ folder; the merge landed and stays. Records on main: session-tiers bullet, debt new-standing-first-start-no-role, note standing-mirror-fetch-unread. Open: whether a brand-new standing session's first start records a role (debt, unverified). The red case for the real hook is on lane/verify-skill-per-repo-tests (step verify-skill-per-repo).
